title: Divine Mercy Novena
description: A nine-day novena given by Jesus Himself to St. Faustina, prayed especially during the octave of Easter. This powerful devotion focuses on God's infinite mercy and our call to trust completely in His compassion.
intention: For God's mercy upon ourselves and the whole world, conversion of sinners, and trust in divine compassion
instructions: This novena was dictated by Jesus to St. Faustina and is traditionally prayed from Good Friday to Divine Mercy Sunday (the Sunday after Easter). However, it can be prayed at any time. Each day focuses on a different group of souls that Jesus wants us to bring to His merciful Heart. Include your personal intentions while offering prayers for these specific groups.
background_info: The Divine Mercy devotion was revealed to St. Faustina Kowalska in the 1930s. Jesus asked her to spread devotion to His Divine Mercy, promising great graces to those who trust in His mercy and show mercy to others. The famous image shows Jesus with red and pale rays emanating from His Heart, representing the Blood and Water that flowed from His pierced side. The chaplet and novena are powerful prayers for obtaining God's mercy.

days.title: Day 1: All Mankind, Especially Sinners
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Most Merciful Jesus, whose very name makes the heart tremble, You are the joy of repentant hearts and the source of compassion for the souls struggling with sin. Today I bring to You all mankind, especially all sinners, and I immerse them in the ocean of Your mercy. Most Merciful Jesus, You yourself have said, 'I desire not the death of a sinner, but rather that he be converted and live.' O source of life, unfathomable Divine Mercy, envelop the whole world and empty Yourself out upon us. O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fountain of mercy for us, I trust in You! Eternal Father, look with mercy upon the whole human race encased in the Most Compassionate Heart of Jesus, and for the sake of His sorrowful Passion, show us Your mercy, that we may praise the omnipotence of Your mercy for endless ages. Amen.
days.reflection: Jesus begins this novena by asking us to pray for all humanity, especially sinners. His mercy is not limited to the 'worthy' but is poured out especially on those who most need it. We are all sinners in need of mercy, and we pray that all people may experience God's compassionate love.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, I trust in Your mercy. Today I pray especially for all sinners and for my own need of Your forgiveness: [pause for personal intentions].
days.scripture: "But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us." - Romans 5:8

days.title: Day 2: The Souls of Priests and Religious
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Most Merciful Jesus, from whom comes all that is good, increase Your grace in men and women consecrated to Your service, that they may perform worthy works of mercy; and that all who see them may glorify the Father of Mercy who is in heaven. Today I bring to You the souls of priests and religious, and immerse them in Your unfathomable mercy. You gave them the strength to renounce everything and to follow You. You are the source of strength for their souls and You alone can strengthen them. O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fountain of mercy for us, I trust in You! Eternal Father, look with mercy upon the company of chosen ones in Your vineyard - the souls of priests and religious; and grant them the strength of Your blessing. For the love of the Heart of Your Son in which they are enfolded, impart to them Your power and light, that they may be able to guide others in the way of salvation and with one voice sing praise to Your boundless mercy for ages without end. Amen.
days.reflection: Priests and religious have dedicated their lives to serving God and His people. They need our prayers and God's special graces to fulfill their calling faithfully. Their ministry is essential for the salvation of souls and the growth of the Church.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, I pray for all priests and religious. Strengthen them in their vocation and help them to be faithful instruments of Your mercy.
days.scripture: "How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of those who bring good news, who proclaim peace, who bring good tidings, who proclaim salvation." - Isaiah 52:7

days.title: Day 3: All Devout and Faithful Souls
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Most Merciful Jesus, from the treasury of Your mercy, You impart Your graces in great abundance to each and all. Receive us into the abode of Your Most Compassionate Heart and never let us escape from It. We beg this grace of You by that most wondrous love for the heavenly Father with which Your Heart burns so fiercely. Today I bring to You all devout and faithful souls, and I immerse them in the ocean of Your mercy. These souls brought You consolation on the Way of the Cross. They were that drop of consolation in the midst of an ocean of bitterness. O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fountain of mercy for us, I trust in You! Eternal Father, look with mercy upon faithful souls, as upon the inheritance of Your Son. For His sorrowful Passion, grant them Your blessing and surround them with Your constant protection. That they may never fail in love or lose the treasure of the holy faith, but rather, with all the hosts of Angels and Saints, may they glorify Your boundless mercy for endless ages. Amen.
days.reflection: Faithful souls who strive to live according to God's will bring consolation to the Heart of Jesus. Even these devoted souls need God's mercy and grace to persevere in their faith journey and to continue growing in holiness.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, I pray for all faithful souls who strive to follow You. Grant them perseverance and continued growth in Your love.
days.scripture: "Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things." - Matthew 25:21

days.title: Day 4: Those Who Do Not Know Jesus
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Most compassionate Jesus, You are the Light of the whole world. Receive into the abode of Your Most Compassionate Heart the souls of those who do not know You. Let the rays of Your grace enlighten them that they, too, together with us, may extol Your wonderful mercy; and do not let them escape from the abode of Your Most Compassionate Heart. Today I bring to You those who do not know You, and those who do not acknowledge You as their God. I was thinking of them during Your bitter Passion, and Your Heart is aware of their future conversion. They will glorify Your mercy when Your promise is fulfilled. O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fountain of mercy for us, I trust in You! Eternal Father, look with mercy upon the souls of those who do not know You, but who are enclosed in the Most Compassionate Heart of Jesus. Draw them by Your light into the kingdom of Your Son. Let these souls, too, glorify Your wonderful mercy for endless ages. Amen.
days.reflection: Jesus' mercy extends to all people, including those who have never heard the Gospel or who have not yet recognized Him as their Savior. We pray that God's light may shine upon them and that they may come to know His love.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, I pray for all who do not yet know You. Send Your light into their hearts and help them to discover Your love.
days.scripture: "The Lord is not slow in keeping his promise, as some understand slowness. Instead he is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish, but everyone to come to repentance." - 2 Peter 3:9

days.title: Day 5: The Souls of Separated Brethren
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Most Merciful Jesus, who are Goodness Itself, You do not refuse light to those who seek it of You. Receive into the abode of Your Most Compassionate Heart the souls of our separated brethren. Draw them by Your light into the unity of the Church, and do not let them escape from the abode of Your Most Compassionate Heart; but bring it about that they, too, come to glorify the generosity of Your mercy. Today I bring to You the souls of our separated brethren, who have torn away and wasted Your blessings and misused Your graces by obstinately persisting in their errors. Do not look upon their errors, but upon the love of Your own Heart and upon all the good that is still in them. O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fountain of mercy for us, I trust in You! Eternal Father, look with mercy upon the souls of our separated brethren, scattered like sheep which have no shepherd. Grant that they may recognize the voice of Your Son. Unite them to the flock so that there will be one flock and one shepherd, and they may glorify Your wonderful mercy for endless ages. Amen.
days.reflection: Jesus desires the unity of all Christians. We pray for our separated brothers and sisters in other Christian denominations, that the Holy Spirit may guide all Christians toward the unity that Christ desires for His Church.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, I pray for Christian unity. May all who call upon Your name be drawn together in truth and love.
days.scripture: "I have other sheep that are not of this sheep pen. I must bring them also. They too will listen to my voice, and there shall be one flock and one shepherd." - John 10:16

days.title: Day 6: The Meek and Humble Souls and Little Children
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Sun, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Most Merciful Jesus, You yourself have said, 'Learn from Me for I am meek and humble of heart.' Receive into the abode of Your Most Compassionate Heart all meek and humble souls and the souls of little children. These souls send all heaven into ecstasy and they are the heavenly Father's favorites. They are a sweet-smelling bouquet before the throne of God; God himself takes delight in their fragrance. These souls have a permanent abode in Your Most Compassionate Heart, O Jesus, and they unceasingly sing out a hymn of love and mercy. Today I bring to You the meek and humble souls and the souls of little children. Drown them in Your unfathomable mercy. These souls most closely resemble Your Heart. They strengthen others to do good. O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fountain of mercy for us, I trust in You! Eternal Father, look with mercy upon meek souls, upon humble souls, and upon little children who are enfolded in the abode which is the Most Compassionate Heart of Jesus. These souls bear the closest resemblance to Your Son. Their fragrance rises from the earth and reaches Your very throne. Father of mercy and of all goodness, I beg You by the love You bear these souls and by the delight You take in them: Bless the whole world, that all souls together may sing out the praises of Your mercy for endless ages. Amen.
days.reflection: Jesus has a special love for those who are meek and humble, and for children who trust simply and completely. These souls teach us how to approach God with the right attitude of heart - with humility, trust, and childlike faith.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, help me to become meek and humble like You. I pray for all children and those who have childlike trust in You.
days.scripture: "Truly I tell you, unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven." - Matthew 18:3

days.title: Day 7: The Souls Who Especially Venerate and Glorify Jesus' Mercy
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Most Merciful Jesus, whose Heart is Love Itself, receive into the abode of Your Most Compassionate Heart the souls of those who particularly extol and venerate the greatness of Your mercy. These souls are mighty with the very power of God Himself. In the midst of all afflictions and adversities they go forward, confident of Your mercy; and united to You, O Jesus, they carry all mankind on their shoulders. These souls will not be judged severely, but Your mercy will embrace them as they depart from this life. Today I bring to You the souls of those who venerate and glorify Your mercy. They brought me strength when I faltered and they will keep me faithful to You until the end. O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fountain of mercy for us, I trust in You! Eternal Father, look with mercy upon the souls of those who glorify and venerate Your greatest attribute, that of Your fathomless mercy, and who are enclosed in the Most Compassionate Heart of Jesus. These souls are a living Gospel; their hands are full of deeds of mercy, and their hearts, overflowing with joy, sing a canticle of mercy to You, the Most High. I beg You O God: Show them Your mercy according to the hope and trust they have placed in You. Let there be accomplished in them the promise of Jesus who said to them that during their life, but especially at the hour of death, the souls who will venerate this image will not perish. Amen.
days.reflection: Those who have a special devotion to Divine Mercy become powerful intercessors and instruments of God's compassion. Their trust in God's mercy gives them strength to serve others and to persevere through difficulties.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, I want to be among those who glorify Your mercy. Help me to trust in You completely and to show mercy to others.
days.scripture: "Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy." - Matthew 5:7

days.title: Day 8: The Souls Who Are Detained in Purgatory
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Most compassionate Jesus, You Yourself have said that You desire mercy; so I bring to the abode of Your Most Compassionate Heart the souls in Purgatory, souls who are very dear to You, and yet, who must make retribution to Your justice. May the streams of Blood and Water which gushed forth from Your Heart put out the flames of Purgatory, that there, too, the power of Your mercy may be celebrated. Today I bring to You the souls detained in Purgatory, and I immerse them in the unfathomable depths of Your mercy. Let the torrents of Your Blood and Water extinguish the flames of purification. Look upon them with Your mercy. I firmly believe that Your goodness and compassion are without limit. O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fountain of mercy for us, I trust in You! Eternal Father, look with mercy upon the souls suffering in Purgatory, who are enfolded in the Most Compassionate Heart of Jesus. I beg You, by the sorrowful Passion of Jesus Your Son, and by all the bitterness with which His most sacred Soul was flooded: Manifest Your mercy to the souls who are under Your just scrutiny. Look upon them in no other way but only through the Face of Your Son, Jesus, for we firmly believe that there is no limit to Your goodness and compassion. Amen.
days.reflection: The souls in purgatory are being purified to enter heaven, but they cannot pray for themselves. Our prayers and sacrifices can help speed their journey to eternal happiness. They will remember our kindness and pray for us when they reach heaven.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, I pray for all the souls in purgatory, especially [mention deceased loved ones]. May Your mercy shorten their purification and bring them quickly to heaven.
days.scripture: "It is therefore a holy and wholesome thought to pray for the dead, that they may be loosed from sins." - 2 Maccabees 12:46

days.title: Day 9: The Souls Who Have Become Lukewarm
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Most compassionate Jesus, You are Compassion Itself. I bring to Your Heart the lukewarm souls and immerse them in the abode of Your Most Compassionate Heart. This fire of Your pure love will purify them. O my Jesus, above all I trust in Your mercy; You will not reject a soul that with trust desires to be united to You. Today I bring to You the souls who have become lukewarm, and I immerse them in the abyss of Your mercy. These souls wound Your loving Heart most painfully. My Jesus, do not let me be indifferent to their great misery. Kindle in them the fire of Your pure love, for You can do all things. O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fountain of mercy for us, I trust in You! Eternal Father, have mercy upon lukewarm souls who are nonetheless enfolded in the Most Compassionate Heart of Jesus. Most compassionate Jesus, exercise the omnipotence of Your mercy and draw them into the very ardor of Your love, and grant them the gift of holy love, for nothing is beyond Your power. Amen.
days.reflection: Lukewarm souls are those who have grown indifferent in their faith - neither hot nor cold, but spiritually tepid. Jesus finds this particularly painful because these souls know Him but have allowed their love to grow cold. We pray for renewal and rekindling of their first love.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, I pray for all lukewarm souls, including myself when I grow spiritually cold. Rekindle the fire of Your love in all our hearts.
days.scripture: "So, because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to spit you out of my mouth." - Revelation 3:16

source: Given by Jesus to St. Faustina Kowalska
notes: This novena is traditionally prayed from Good Friday to Divine Mercy Sunday, but can be prayed at any time. Each day focuses on bringing a different group of souls to God's mercy. The Divine Mercy Chaplet can be prayed along with this novena. Jesus promised great graces to those who pray this novena and trust in His mercy.
